Matthew Hayden backs Dinesh Karthik for CSK coaching role

Former Australian cricketer Matthew Hayden has stated that Indian wicketkeeper-batsman Dinesh Karthik would be a "really good choice" for the vacant coaching position at the Chennai Super Kings (CSK). CSK is currently seeking a new coach following the departure of Stephen Fleming, who concluded his extensive tenure with the five-time Indian Premier League champions.
